## Lisbon Apartment Snapshot for a Couple Starting 2026-09-01
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg

You’re comparing three lease options for a 12-month stay in Lisbon, with **safety, commute, and space** as the main priorities and a **€1,400/month cap**.

## Ranked Options by Fit
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

| Option | Rent | Size | Commute to Downtown | Fit for Couple | Budget Status |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| 1-bedroom in Arroios | €1,250/mo | 55 m² | 12 min | Best balance of space and commute | Within budget |
| 1-bedroom in Campo de Ourique | €1,450/mo | 60 m² | 25 min | Quietest and largest, strongest lifestyle fit | Over budget |
| Studio in Alfama | €1,100/mo | 42 m² | 20 min | Cheapest, but least space for two | Within budget |

### Best Fit: 1-bedroom in Arroios
- **Why it wins:** It stays comfortably under budget, gives you a true 1-bedroom layout, and has the **shortest commute** of the three.
- **Trade-off:** It may not feel as quiet as Campo de Ourique, but it is the strongest all-around match for a couple prioritizing daily convenience and livability.
- **Safety note:** Among the three, Arroios is often seen as a practical central area with good transit access; for a couple, that usually matters more than the extra quiet of a more residential neighborhood.

### Runner-up: 1-bedroom in Campo de Ourique
- **Why it’s attractive:** Best for **space and quiet**, and likely the most comfortable long-term home.
- **Why it loses:** It is **over budget by €50/month** and has the longest commute.
- **Use if:** You’re willing to stretch budget slightly for a calmer neighborhood and extra room.

### Budget Option: Studio in Alfama
- **Why it works:** Lowest rent and still inside budget.
- **Why it’s weaker:** A **42 m² studio** is the tightest option for a couple over a 12-month lease, and the commute is only middling.
- **Use if:** Cost savings matter more than having separate sleeping/living space.

## Best Choice Under €1,400
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/star.svg

**1-bedroom in Arroios** is the best fit under your budget.

- **Best balance:** commute + space + price
- **Monthly headroom:** €150 below your cap
- **Couple-friendly:** separate bedroom makes a big difference for a year-long lease
- **Practicality:** easiest commute of the three
